content:
We need DBE for C5H9OCl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). O ignored. So treat Cl as H. So effective H = 9 + 1 =10. No N. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 =5 -10/2 +1 =5 -5 +1 =1. So DBE =1.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe.
